remarks: Welcome to Stamford! Voted as one of the best places to live in Connecticut... it's a vibrant city that will not disappoint! Fall love with this beautifully updated home, located in the coveted "Cove" neighborhood. Set up as a magnificent single-family residence...you'll have the ability to convert (or expand) it into a 2 family, due to its current R5 Zone (should you choose). From the vaulted ceiling to the chic artistic loft (with spiral staircase), this home is full of picturesque surprises! Light, bright, and warm... it boasts a recently renovated kitchen (with white shaker cabinets, stainless steel appliances, and quartz countertops). Remodeled bathrooms (with amazing stonework, hand selected fixtures, and built in skylight). Recessed lighting, hardwood floors, and a fully finished basement (with its own separate entrance)! You'll love entertaining on the expansive outdoor deck (overlooking the enormous fully fenced yard). This unique find is centrally located to all of Stamford's best amenities. Walk to Chelsea Piers for Swimming, Tennis, Basketball, Lacrosse, and much more!  Head to the 79-acre Cummings Beach and Park (4 minutes away) ...or head to Cove Island Park for walking trails, playgrounds and cycling paths! Close proximity to schools, shopping, entertainment, train station, and I-95.... Don't let this one pass you by. Schedule your viewing today!
